title: Build Lookup Table
goal: Convert owned tuples into a HashMap without unnecessary key allocations.
hints: The input vector already owns the String keys.
into_iter moves owned values out of the vector without cloning or copying.
explanation: into_iter moves owned String keys and values directly into the HashMap. iter produces references so collect cannot build a map of owned String keys. Iterating over a reference vector yields references and causes a type mismatch.
